gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS item_amount_per_customer FROM retail.order_items oi JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN retail.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
question: 各客户州的每客户商品额（SUM(price) / distinct customer_id）前 10 名是多少？

gold_sql: SELECT ym, product_category_name_english, item_amount FROM (SELECT to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'YYYY') AS ym, t.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) AS item_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'YYYY') ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS rn FROM retail.order_items oi JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN retail.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1, 2) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ym
question: 每个年度（'YYYY'）商品额最高的英文产品类别及其金额是什么？

gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_purchase_timestamp::date)) AS avg_delivery_days FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
question: 各客户州的平均送达天数（只统计已交付且有签收时间）降序排列是多少？

gold_sql: SELECT pay.payment_installments, pay.payment_type, SUM(pay.payment_value) AS payment_amount FROM retail.order_payments pay JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = pay.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

gold_sql: SELECT SUM(top10.item_amount) / (SELECT SUM(price) FROM retail.order_items) AS top10_seller_share FROM (SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS item_amount FROM retail.order_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) top10

gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price) AS freight_to_item_ratio FROM retail.order_items oi JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN retail.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(oi.price) > 50000 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
